label: Text 1
transcript: Sam wakes up at 6:30. He brushes his teeth, lets the cat out, eats two pieces of toast, and walks to school. Lina wakes up at 7:00, runs out the door at 7:25, and arrives at school out of breath at 7:55. She still gets there before the bell. Sam doesn't understand how.
